claims.exact_statement: For every fixed finite actual exponent-arrow diagram satisfying the essential-source endotactic condition, fixed finite affine slope family with the stated activity tolerance, scale h satisfying K L h^H <= kappa H, every x=h^p in B_h, every active slope r, and every pointwise rate vector k_e in [kappa,K], one has r dot f >= 0; if r is not in S-perp then r dot f >= kappa H h^M > 0.
assumptions: Finite actual diagram; all source and target vectors belong to the finite vertex set C.
Endotacticity is imposed only on essential edges with nonzero directional reaction projection; every such edge at the maximal source tier is strictly inward.
The active slope belongs to the finite family fixed before h and satisfies the coordinate/source-difference activity bound.
Rates satisfy one common supplied interval 0 < kappa <= k_e(t) <= K < infinity.
M is max_e ||y_e||_1 and L is sum_e ||nu_e||_1; zero-span case is handled separately.
claims.novelty_boundary: OA149 supplies the affine tolerance/plateau mechanism and a fixed-rate weakly reversible mass-action theorem. Its trapping proof uses a weakly reversible return path. The all-endotactic pointwise bounded-measurable-rate drift is the candidate's separate extension; neither source import nor this audit certifies priority.
claims.costs: Finite but nonconstructive affine family; no useful family-size, real-coefficient bit precision, scale threshold, or entry-time bound is supplied. Fixed-scale evaluation cost does not include family acquisition.
claims.falsifier: An endotactic diagram and active slope satisfying the stated comparison margin for which a negative projected edge is not strictly above the minimum essential source tier, or a rate-box corner makes the projected flux nonpositive, would refute the lemma transfer.
claims.next_gate: External independent proof review or formalization of the affine activity lemma plus the weighted tier comparison; keep source theorem status separate.

claims.exact_statement: For the fixed affine family and class scale hP, the global convex plateau K_h is compact positive and lies in int B_sqrt(h); box-conditional strict drift gives finite entry; every positive initial point lies in some sufficiently deep K_h0; the capped square-root sequence reaches hP in finitely many steps and yields the common class absorber without any nesting assumption on K_h.
assumptions: All conclusions of PH-N33-DRIFT-01 and its uniform active-slope corollary.
The finite-minimum chain rule is used almost everywhere along Caratheodory solutions.
Class is fixed as P=(c+S) intersect R^d_{>0}; neutral slopes are excluded below K_h using x-c in S.
claims.novelty_boundary: OA149 already uses the classwise plateau and scale progression for its narrower source theorem. The current candidate's use depends on its new common pointwise drift. This audit confirms the logical transfer only under that drift; it is not external validation.
claims.costs: Finite path-independent entry bound for each x0 is existential. It depends on x0 through h0 and the finite transition count; no uniform bound over an unbounded P is claimed. W_h and hP have no useful quantitative acquisition/precision bound.
claims.falsifier: A scale sequence satisfying h_(j+1)=min(sqrt(h_j),hP) for which K_hj subset int B_sqrt(h_j) fails to imply continued residence in B_h(j+1), or failure of finite box-entry/invariance under measurable rates, would refute the absorption step.
claims.next_gate: Keep entry-time quantifiers explicit in synthesis; formalize the finite-minimum a.e. chain rule and Caratheodory continuation if formal assurance is required.

claims.exact_statement: Common stoichiometric span is necessary for the stated classwide absorber under arbitrary switching among modes: switching forever to mode 0<->A leaves B constant for the mode family (0<->A, 0<->B), whose union span is R^2.
assumptions: Switching can select a single mode with zero weight on other modes.
The requested absorber would be common over the union-span positive class.
claims.status: exact counterexample to the different-span generalization; consistent with N33 scope
claims.novelty_boundary: Boundary check only; it does not refute the single-diagram theorem or the common-span switching result.
claims.costs: No acquisition cost; exact two-dimensional linear dynamics.
claims.falsifier: A uniform compact absorber over arbitrary positive initial A,B under mode-A-only switching would contradict B(t)=B(0).
claims.next_gate: Preserve exact common-span hypothesis in any switching extension.
